title: Telco reintroduces zero lock-in postpaid plans
summary: Mobile services provider Smart Communications, Inc. (Smart) is giving Filipinos greater freedom to experience postpaid with its All-New Postpaid Plans+, offering a zero lock-in option alongside…

blocks.text: Mobile services provider Smart Communications, Inc. (Smart) is giving Filipinos greater freedom to experience postpaid with its All-New Postpaid Plans+, offering a zero lock-in option alongside unlimited access to select apps for social media, productivity, content creation, and gaming.

Available on Plan+ 999 to Plan+ 2499, the zero lock-in option allows customers to enjoy postpaid without a long-term plan contract, offering greater flexibility for those who want to experience its benefits while keeping their options open.
For customers who have been considering postpaid but may be hesitant about a long-term commitment, Smart’s zero lock-in option provides a more flexible way to finally make the upgrade.

Meanwhile, those who prefer a standard contract can also enjoy added value through bonus monthly data, with the 6-Month Lock-In option providing an extra 2GB of data per month for six months, while the 12-Month Lock-In option comes with an extra 3GB of data per month for 12 months.
These options let customers choose between the flexibility of zero lock-in and the added data benefits of a fixed-term plan, depending on their needs and preferences.
Unli Apps for social and gaming
The All-New Postpaid Plans+ also feature Unli Apps bundles, which provide unlimited data access to select apps based on subscribers’ digital lifestyles.
For staying connected with friends and family, the Unli Connect Bundle offers unlimited data access to TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, and WhatsApp.
For learning, productivity, and content creation, the Unli Create Bundle covers YouTube, Google AI via Gemini, and Google productivity apps, including Gmail, Drive, Maps, Meet, and Photos.
For mobile gaming enthusiasts, the Unli Play Bundle provides unlimited data access to Mobile Legends: Bang Bang, Call of Duty: Mobile, and Honor of Kings.
The All-New Smart Postpaid Plans+ come in five tiers to suit different connectivity needs:

items: Plan+ 799: 15GB of data, 100GB of 5G-only data for six months, and the Unli Create App Bundle for six months.
Plan+ 999: 20GB of data, Unli 5G for 12 months, and a choice of one Unli Apps bundle for 12 months.
Plan+ 1499: 40GB of data, Unli 5G for 12 months, and a choice of one Unli Apps bundle for 12 months.
Plan+ 1999: 60GB of data, Unli 5G for 12 months, and a choice of one Unli Apps bundle for 12 months.

blocks.text: All plans include unlimited all-network mobile calls and texts, unlimited Smart-to-Smart video calls via Video over LTE (ViLTE) on compatible Android phones, and unlimited landline calls, excluding special numbers. Smart Postpaid subscribers also enjoy priority network access, exclusive perks and lifestyle experiences, and access to the latest devices.
